html:
On 27 February 1844 Dominican rebels seized the Puerta del Conde in Santo Domingo and declared independence from Haiti. The day is the national day of the Dominican Republic.

The rising was planned by the secret society La Trinitaria of Juan Pablo Duarte, with Francisco del Rosario Sanchez and Matias Ramon Mella. Haitian armies invaded several times over the next twelve years and were beaten back.

Power soon passed to strongmen such as Pedro Santana, who exiled Duarte. Fearing Haiti, Santana handed the country back to Spain in 1861, which led to the Restoration War. The new state was born after twenty two years of Haitian rule.
sum: On 27 February 1844 Dominican rebels seized the Puerta del Conde in Santo Domingo and declared independence from Haiti. The day is the national day of the Dominican Republic.
